manifest.name: Calendar
manifest.description: Your calendars in one place: ICS feeds and CalDAV accounts (Google, iCloud, Nextcloud, Fastmail, Radicale …).
widget.agenda.name: Agenda
widget.month.name: Month
widget.month.description: A month grid with event dots.
widget.next.name: Next up
page.calendar.name: Calendar
widget.agenda.errors: some accounts failed, check the calendar page.
preset.google.label: Google
preset.google.hint: google only allows oauth on caldav, so use the per-calendar feed: google calendar (web) → settings → pick the calendar → 'integrate calendar' → copy the 'secret address in ical format' and paste it here. one account per calendar. nobody but you should see that url.
preset.icloud.label: iCloud
preset.icloud.hint: username = your full apple id e-mail. password = an app-specific password: appleid.apple.com → sign-in and security → app-specific passwords (two-factor authentication has to be on). your normal apple password is rejected with 401.
preset.nextcloud.label: Nextcloud
preset.nextcloud.hint: the base url of your nextcloud. use an app password (settings → security → devices & sessions).
preset.fastmail.label: Fastmail
preset.fastmail.hint: username = your fastmail address, password = an app password with calendar access.
preset.caldav.label: other CalDAV
preset.caldav.hint: radicale, baikal, synology, posteo, mailbox.org … any caldav server.
preset.ics.label: ICS / webcal feed
preset.ics.hint: any .ics url, e.g. a public holiday calendar, a shared google calendar address, a sports schedule.
field.name: name
form.passwordNote: passwords are stored on your hub only (module storage in the hub's sqlite). use app passwords, never your main account password.
settings.accountsHint: accounts are managed on the calendar page (sidebar → calendar → accounts).
error.google: google calendar only allows oauth on caldav, app passwords are rejected. use the calendar's 'secret address in ical format' (google calendar → settings → your calendar → integrate calendar) as an ics feed instead.
error.401.icloud: icloud rejected the login (401). use an app-specific password from appleid.apple.com → sign-in and security → app-specific passwords (two-factor auth must be on), and your full apple id e-mail as username.
error.401.fastmail: fastmail rejected the login (401). create an app password with calendar access under settings → privacy & security → integrations.
error.401: {host} rejected the login (401). most servers want an app password instead of your account password; check username (often the full e-mail) and password.
error.principal: could not find a caldav account at {host}. check the server url (for nextcloud the base url is enough, for others try the full caldav url your provider documents).
error.403: {host} answered 403 forbidden: the account is valid but may not allow caldav access or this app password lacks calendar rights.
error.invalidUrl: that is not a valid http(s) url
error.notCalendar: {host} did not return a calendar ({type}, no BEGIN:VCALENDAR) – is this the web page instead of the .ics link?
error.invalidRange: from/to must be ISO dates, from before to, at most {days} days apart
page.partial: some accounts could not be loaded for this range.
